# pbs_acl (Resource)

Manages a single PBS access control list (ACL) entry, granting a role to a user or API token on a path.

An entry is identified by `path`, `auth_id` and `role`; changing any of them replaces the entry.
Only `propagate` can be updated in place.

**Notes:**

* `NoAccess` is exclusive in PBS: assigning it removes all other roles of the same `auth_id` on that path,
  and assigning any other role removes an existing `NoAccess` entry there. Never combine a `NoAccess` entry
  with other `pbs_acl` resources for the same `auth_id` and path, otherwise they keep removing each other
  and Terraform keeps re-creating them.
* Deleting a user in PBS removes its API tokens and their ACL entries, but not the ACL entries of the user itself.
* Groups are not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pbs_user" "backup" {
  userid = "backup@pbs"
}

resource "pbs_api_token" "backup" {
  userid     = pbs_user.backup.userid
  token_name = "client"
}

# Allow the user to back up into the datastore "store1".
resource "pbs_acl" "backup_user" {
  path    = "/datastore/store1"
  auth_id = pbs_user.backup.userid
  role    = "DatastoreBackup"
}

# Grant the API token read access to a single namespace only.
resource "pbs_acl" "backup_token" {
  path      = "/datastore/store1/clients"
  auth_id   = pbs_api_token.backup.tokenid
  role      = "DatastoreReader"
  propagate = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_id` (String) User ID (`user@realm`) or API token ID (`user@realm!token`) the role is granted to. It must exist.
- `path` (String) ACL path, e.g. `/`, `/datastore/store1`, `/datastore/store1/ns1`, `/remote/remote1`, `/system` or `/tape`. The referenced object (e.g. the datastore) need not exist.
- `role` (String) Role to grant. One of: `Admin`, `Audit`, `NoAccess`, `DatastoreAdmin`, `DatastoreReader`, `DatastoreBackup`, `DatastorePowerUser`, `DatastoreAudit`, `RemoteAudit`, `RemoteAdmin`, `RemoteSyncOperator`, `RemoteSyncPushOperator`, `RemoteDatastorePowerUser`, `RemoteDatastoreAdmin`, `TapeAudit`, `TapeAdmin`, `TapeOperator`, `TapeReader`.

### Optional

- `propagate` (Boolean) Whether the role also applies to all paths below `path`. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the ACL entry in the format `<path>:<auth_id>:<role>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# ACL entries are imported by "<path>:<auth_id>:<role>".
terraform import pbs_acl.backup_user "/datastore/store1:backup@pbs:DatastoreBackup"
terraform import pbs_acl.backup_token "/datastore/store1/clients:backup@pbs!client:DatastoreReader"
```
